purpose: Prevent repeated optimizer rounds from tuning against a permanently reusable holdout by enforcing time-ordered evaluate-before-adapt semantics and expiring consumed holdout evidence from current promotion authority.
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local repeated-round trace only; no statistical guarantee beyond the fixed chronological evidence sequence.

chronological_evidence.rule: evaluate frozen pair first, then mark R1 consumed; only later generations may use R1 for tuning
failure cannot be repaired by tuning on R_BAD and retesting R_BAD in the same generation

promotion_rule: A candidate may be promoted in generation 41 only after the pair frozen before R1/R2 sees both fresh items as terminal PASS and those artifacts are sealed/read back. Prior consumed holdout evidence cannot substitute for R1/R2.
adaptation_rule: After a fresh evidence item has been terminally evaluated, it may enter immutable history and can influence a later generation's checker selection, but never the same generation whose evaluation it scored.

fixed_trace.event: reuse prior consumed holdout as if fresh
evaluate frozen generation-41 pair on R1 then R2 before any adaptation
fixed_trace.expected: both PASS; generation-41 promotion may proceed after readback
ignore as consumed duplicate; no extra credit/evidence count
no promotion; mark failure terminal; do not tune on R_BAD and immediately retest it in generation 42
may affect generation 43 only; requires new fresh evaluation evidence

fixed_trace.control: no new fresh evidence after adaptation
fixed_trace.expected: remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: prior holdout remains immutable history but is expired from current promotion authority once consumed
guards.G2: checker pair is frozen before fresh chronological evaluation evidence is read for that generation
guards.G3: fresh evidence is evaluated before it can influence adaptation
guards.G4: same evidence item cannot both tune and validate the same generation
guards.G5: R1/R2 must be unique fresh terminal evidence to qualify generation-41 promotion
guards.G6: duplicate or stale consumed evidence cannot add evaluation weight or credit
guards.G7: R_BAD failure cannot be erased by same-generation tune-and-retest
guards.G8: post-R_BAD adaptation can affect generation 43 only and needs new fresh evaluation evidence
guards.G9: transport failure/UNKNOWN/scope mismatch never count as fresh PASS
guards.G10: absence of new fresh evidence leaves controller unresolved with nonempty frontier
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source chronology or rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one credit after terminal readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode; preserve the limitation that evaluate-before-adapt ordering does not by itself guarantee representative future evidence.
